offering_description.value: Leases Gamma Knife and proton therapy radiosurgery systems to hospitals and cancer centers under long-term contracts. It also develops and finances equipment placements, and holds an interest in a Gamma Knife and other cancer treatment centers.

primary_services.value: leasing of radiosurgery equipment; equipment financing and placement; treatment center management

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, medical centers and cancer treatment centers

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: per-procedure or fixed lease fees from hospitals for Gamma Knife and similar systems; service fees: management and support of treatment centers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: buys radiosurgery systems from manufacturers and leases them to hospitals

geography_served.value: global: United States hospitals plus international sites in South America, Turkey and Asia

specialization.value: niche specialist: leasing of radiosurgery and radiation therapy equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with hospitals and cancer centers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: healthcare equipment and radiation devices subject to FDA, NRC and state rules, hospital reimbursement rules
